articles.title: Content Marketplace Bunqer Debuts at MIP London
articles.mainIdea: Content Marketplace Bunqer Debuts at MIP London
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Content Marketplace Bunqer Debuts at MIP London. New B2B content marketplace Bunqer.tech is debuting, with a Beta version, at MIP London and will launch at the end of 2026. Thanks to key partnerships and technical innovation using AI, the platform enables content players across the world to buy and sell their programs in just a few clicks, like online shopping, bringing new sources of revenue in a quick, simple and automatic manner.
